text.description_html:
Acorn PPBYP, Hand Painted Leaves And Berries Cabinet Pull

Acorn's Leaves and Berries Pull is perfect for adding an artful touch to your home; making it the perfect statement detail for all sorts of applications, be it in the kitchen, the bathroom, or on an end table in the living room. There are two colors to choose from and each of those is available in both large and small lengths. Trust us when we say that the pictures do not do this pull justice--the colors are vibrant and every piece has been hand painted by an artist, making it a real beautiful piece.

Features of the Leaves And Berries Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Can be mounted horizontally or vertically.
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Available Types:

    PPBYP - Large Dark Blue Leaves and Berries Ceramic Pull:
    • Center to Center: 4"
    • Overall Length: 5-1/2"
    • Width: 1-1/4"

    PPCYP - Small Dark Blue Leaves and Berries Ceramic Pull:
    • Center to Center: 3"
    • Overall Length: 4-7/8"
    • Width: 1-3/16"

    PP9YP - Large Yellow Leaves and Berries Ceramic Pull:
    • Center to Center: 4"
    • Overall Length: 5-1/2"
    • Width: 1-1/4"

    PPAYP - Small Yellow Leaves and Berries Ceramic Pull:
    • Center to Center: 3"
    • Overall Length: 4-7/8"
    • Width: 1-3/16"

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
